description: This header defines interfaces and classes for managing F1-U gateway bearers in a 5G network, including notifier interfaces, gateway interfaces, and specific UDP gateway implementation within the ocudu::odu namespace.

classes.name: f1u_du_gateway_bearer_rx_notifier
classes.description: Interface for a notifier that handles new PDU events inside the DU F1-U gateway.

classes.name: f1u_du_gateway_bearer
classes.description: Interface for an F1-U gateway bearer, extending the PDU notifier.

classes.name: f1u_du_gateway
classes.description: Main interface for managing F1-U bearers, including creation and address retrieval.

classes.name: f1u_du_udp_gateway
classes.description: Specific implementation of F1-U UDP gateway interface.

methods.name: create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new F1-U bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Retrieves the bind address for a given gNB DU ID.

methods.name: get_bind_port
methods.description: Retrieves the UDP port to bind for the UDP gateway.
